ctx.x: But the Clambake Seven was part of that thing -- I was only with them for 7 or 8 months, now. But I learned a great deal from Tommy, I played a lot of brushes, and we played uptown music, we played downtown music. Dean Kincaid was writing for the band, Tommy had a ...
Dean Kincaid was the lead saxophone player.
